original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克马尼卡省省长承认难以管控非法采金活动
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 莫桑比克马尼卡省省长于10月19日承认，对“seis carros”矿区的非法采矿活动难以管控，该矿区曾聚集约1.2万名手工采矿者，并多次记录死亡事件。9月万杜齐区因非法采矿引发的地面塌陷在三天内造成至少9人死亡。省长表示正推动将手工采矿者组织为合作社，以实现更有序的开采。

key_facts.fact: 马尼卡省省长承认难以管控seis carros矿区的非法采矿活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the governor of the Mozambican province of Manica admitted on Monday, 19 October, that there are difficulties in controlling illegal mining at the “seis carros” mine

key_facts.fact: 该矿区曾聚集超过1.2万名手工采矿者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: We even reached a point where there were more than 12,000 people mining at the ‘seis carros’ mine

key_facts.fact: 9月万杜齐区非法采矿引发的地面塌陷在三天内造成至少9人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In September, at least nine people died over three days as a result of land collapses associated with illegal mining in Vanduzi district

key_facts.fact: 矿区开挖区域目前约20米深、直径25米
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: which is currently around 20 metres deep and 25 metres in diameter

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（Lusa/Club of Mozambique）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
死亡人数及矿区人数为当地政府与省长说法，未获独立核实
